prayerExcerpt.en-US: Grant that in our day too, the Church may grow in holiness through the exemplary zeal of your ministers.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Dai à vossa Igreja, também em nossos dias, crescer em santidade pelo zelo exemplar dos vossos ministros.

meta.face: A spare Castilian priest of about seventy with a LONG, gaunt face, narrow at the jaw — a broad forehead with short, cropped grey hair brushed forward in a thin fringe and receding at the temples, high cheekbones over hollow cheeks, a long, straight nose slightly full at the tip, large, dark, heavy-lidded eyes turned a little down at the outer corners, gentle and grave, under arched grey brows raised toward the middle, a small, thin-lipped mouth; a short, close-clipped grey beard and moustache that only follow the line of the jaw; a gaze of quiet compassion toward the viewer.
meta.basis: The portrait attributed to El Greco (c. 1580), inscribed M. IVAN D. AVILA, shows an old priest with a long, hollow-cheeked face, cropped grey hair, large sad eyes and a short grey beard, one hand on his breast; he died at Montilla at seventy. We keep its marks and drop the heavy shadows under the eyes.
